notes.title: Post-Mortem Discount
notes.content: [p][b]The Post-Mortem Discount is here[/b][/p][p] To celebrate the one-month anniversary of NECRODUNGEON’s release, you can get the game at a special price from August 25 to September 1.[/p][p][/p][p]I also put together a video reflecting on the experience of developing the game solo. It is a simple overview, but it highlights the key moments and challenges of bringing NECRODUNGEON to life.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy it.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Hd1lJzoX0Bs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Endgame Update
notes.content:
[p][b]The new update is live![/b][/p][p]Thanks again for all your feedback. It has been incredibly helpful in shaping this release.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Infinite Run Mode:[/b] Unlocks after finishing the game. You can freely choose the dungeon type and keep leveling and upgrading until you are bored.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Game:[/b] You can now save your progress inside the church at the altar next to the priest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stat Tracking:[/b] In the in-game menu you can track how many enemies you have killed, how much gold you have collected, how many times you have died, and your total playtime.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Buttons on Death:[/b] Return to Church and Restart Dungeon buttons now appear when you die.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][b]What’s been fixed:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]The Baron (Werewolf Boss):[/b] Now stops when howling and stays still until all mobs are dead.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coin Bug:[/b] Fixed an issue where coins would sink into the ground.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Holy Water Balance (sorry):[/b] The first drop now travels straight forward while the others disperse. I think it worked well.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]If you find any bugs, please post them in the community discussion section. I check it almost every day.
[/p][p]Report bugs: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3728400/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3728400/discussions/[/url][/p]

notes.title: SOON: Endgame Expansion
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618654/6b37f2a3516fbb358324cbd0cd3f9cc0d6f3bc1d.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Thanks so much for all your feedback! It's been incredibly helpful.[/p][p]I'm working on a new, more refined update based on what you've shared. The big addition will be an [b]"[/b]infinite run[b]" [/b]mode that unlocks after you finish the main game. Keep leveling up, upgrading, and pushing forward until you get tired of it![/p][p]This update shouldn't take too long to release, but there will be a few days without patches while I focus on getting it right.[/p][p]I’m also adding more detailed stats tracking, like enemies defeated, gold collected, and other fun little insights into your runs.[/p][p]And... Maybe... The hability to remove/sell powers![/p][p]Thanks again for all the support and your patience![/p][p]— Arthur Masseli[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes - August 7
notes.content: [p]You no longer have to TALK TO THE PRIEST after you’ve read the dialogue once. If you die you can simply walk through the door to get back into the dungeon. [/p][p]A “Restart Dungeon” button has been added to the menu, so you can restart a dungeon at any time. [/p][p]The Baron (werewolf boss) now loses collision when he enters invulnerable state, allowing you to shoot mobs through him. [/p][p]The slow effect of the Divine Light skill has been fixed: if you hit an enemy that’s already slowed, the timer now resets. The tutorial now notes that you can rebind power keys in the options menu. [/p]
